limitations: local_detail_loss is a spatially supported worst-local engineering metric, not percentage of whole-image texture erased or retained
unity is an isolation configuration; daily default aligned and auto are tested separately
actual auxiliary100 was full-resolution444f for requested factors1/2 in this case, not a guarantee for every Apple runtime
JPEG, archive, 8-bit and Apple-only paths do not use this new retry
Sony sample uses actual RAW8 and Nikon sample is traditional D750 NEF; no claim Nikon HE/HE* or every Sony codec has been validated
ordinary photographs and synthetic fixtures do not replace independent dark/flat/weak-chroma holdouts
larger HDR files are possible; no fixed20MB claim or gate relaxation
half/float numerical readback investigation is separate from the HDR packaging correction
primary_identity_scope: auxiliary-generation/pre-capture-metadata: reference identity binds donor and installed primary at the writer boundary. Normal capture-metadata repacking may reorder properties and mark the same known ICC colr essential; primary payload and all decoding-property bytes remain identical. Final metadata verification uses inspection plus normalized encoded-content invariance, not a second full pixel HDR gate. The stricter reference identity includes order and essential flags and is not claimed equal across metadata repacking.

metadata_content_identity.scope: all compressed image/tmap payloads, decoder properties, colour profiles and HDR relationships, normalized only for permitted capture-metadata rewrites
metadata_content_identity.signature_digest_representation: UTF-8 Python tuple/bytes repr, exact equality checked before hashing

independent_final_file_readback.scope: independent final full-size fp unity file pixel readback after capture-metadata rewriting, compared with the original packed HDR formation master
